features.title: Plugin updates waiting for a Host restart
features.summary: A Plugins-page row names every plugin whose browser half rebuilt while its Host half still runs from before the rebuild, so the page keeps the last-good client code instead of running new client code against old Host code.
failureModes: A rebuilt client bundle whose Host half did not change applies immediately, as before.
A rebuilt client bundle whose Host half changed is announced as deferred; the browser keeps the last-good code and the row names the package until a Host restart.
A Host that reloads the package in-process releases the deferral and announces the rebuild.

verification.testName: defers while the Host half on disk is not the loaded one
releases a deferral when the Host reloaded that artifact
reads an owned bundle entry from exports

verification.reason: A deferral needs a plugin whose Host half is rebuilt on disk while the Host keeps the old one loaded; no Gherkin scenario sets that up yet. The feature's reach steps open the empty row on a scratch DSH with dshx dev open, and the defer and release decisions are unit-tested in src/host/gate.test.ts.

features.title: Plugin updates waiting for a restart in the Inbox
features.summary: While any rebuilt plugin is held back because its new Host code is not loaded, the Inbox shows one Ready item about this DSH naming the waiting packages and how to apply them (restart when no agent is working). It offers no restart verb: restarting stays the user's decision. A changed set of packages shows again after Done; the item resolves once nothing waits.
failureModes: Without the inbox (activity-timeline) loaded, the gate works exactly as before; the provider reconciles when the inbox announces it is ready.
The item never restarts or reloads anything; it only says what waits and how to apply it.
